quality.basis: 挂起：新写 driver 用 libwiretap 读文件，按超时判定，无标准答案

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: the dataset exploit runs no wiretap code: it greps file_wrappers.c and runs its own copy of a zlib loop.

review.note: picks its SAFE/UNSAFE mode by grepping the source, then runs its own copy of the function (trigger: a hang)

category5.design: No built program reads gzip-compressed capture files, so the same libwiretap reader driver as WF_RAG_6 opens the PoV with wtap_open_offline, which inflates gzip input through file_wrappers.c; a corrupt deflate stream with input left makes the vulnerable zlib_fill_out_buffer spin forever, so the rule is timeout (vulnerable past 10 s on both runs, fixed within). No ground truth.
